after.limitations: Legacy configuration-cache residency and isolation only, not full W38/F32/F08/N07, legacy KV transactional authority, customer workload or release acceptance. Its independent 32-entry/8 MiB charged-serialization budget is not total JS heap or a platform capacity claim; the separate content cache retains its own budget. Mutable values use detached private snapshots and caller-owned clones; this adds bounded cloning work, not per-hit parsing/validation or I/O. Expiry is opportunistic. Provided nowMs semantics remain, with separate elapsed-read safeguards. Original in-flight calls may return original values but cannot refill after local invalidation. Concurrent miss allocation, oversized-document parsing/validation, immutable-history retention, compatibility cutover and whole read/validate/compose/native latency qualification remain separate. No ranking, candidate, model, schema, customer policy, cloud/deploy/install/emitted-build/provision/seed/credential/customer-data/commit/push/destructive/external operations. Prior W31.02/W38.01 byte-specific proof is retained with prospective revalidation qualification; their implemented remedies are preserved. The admitted exact command selects 17 tests: the 16 planned cases plus the existing Reflex history/diffing case matched by the same regex. Root detected this count-label error before runtime (a01dcf); no command or fixture was changed and no extra suite was introduced. The extra existing case covers the same changed legacy store. Actual counts, not the earlier fixed16 label, govern reported execution.
after.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/config/versionedStore.test.ts src/reflex/configStore.test.ts -t 'W38.02|W38.01|rejects concurrent/stale writes|contains every partial put/lost acknowledgement|bounds immutable serving snapshots|versions, attributes|rolls forward on rollback|serves the fallback|merges nested objects instead|accepts the legacy|writes both field names|keeps every revision body|serves repeat reads from the isolate cache|re-reads once the TTL' --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
after.runtime: Distinct Astra/xhigh frozen-source review and same fixed16 once; reuse final static.
